items.source: Creates a new EndpointLinksResolver that will resolve links to the given endpoints that are exposed beneath the given basePath.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 EndpointLinksResolver，用于解析给定 basePath 下公开的给定 endpoints 的链接。

items.source: Creates a new EndpointLinksResolver that will resolve links to the given endpoints.
items.translation: 创建一个新的EndpointLinksResolver，用于解析到给定endpoints的链接。

items.source: Resolves links to the known endpoints based on a request with the given requestUrl.
items.translation: 根据带有给定 requestUrl 的请求解析到已知端点的链接。

items.source: requestUrl - the url of the request for the endpoint links
A resolver for links to web endpoints.
items.translation: 用于 Web 端点 links 的解析器。
